description:
## [1.2.0](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/pancake-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-10-24)

### ✨ New Features

* bstation - add hide bottom navigation items patch ([5e6abeb](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/pancake-patches/commit/5e6abeb82aceacf27177fc62723982ac7ab6f132))
* bstation - add UI debloat and cleanup patches ([c72b79a](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/pancake-patches/commit/c72b79a6260870a36b3d57db8d3140605ee4c252))

patches.name: Clean Me page
patches.description: Hide creator center section and selected menus (campaign, FAQs, feedback) on the Me profile page.

options.description: Hides the Creator Center dashboard card and banner buttons.
Hides promotional/campaign menus.
Hides Help & FAQs menus.
Hides Feedback and report menus.

patches.name: Debloat search landing page
patches.description: Debloats the search landing page by hiding trending searches, discovery modules, and promotional search bar hints.

options.description: Hides trending search hot words and suppresses the network request.
Hides discovery section modules, tabs, and dividers on the search landing page.
Neutralizes promotional default keywords and forces the default 'Search' hint.

patches.name: Disable floating ads
patches.description: Disables bottom-right promotional floating advertisement overlay.

patches.name: Disable inner push banner
patches.description: Disables top slide-down promotional toast and inner-push banner notifications.

patches.name: Disable player outro unlock card
patches.description: Disables video player outro unlock video guide bottom-right card.

patches.name: Disable player overlay ads
patches.description: Disables video player in-stream bottom-right overlay ad banners.

patches.name: Disable player recommendation widget
patches.description: Disables fullscreen video player bottom-right recommendation widget.

patches.name: Disable player watermark
patches.description: Hides the top-right brand logo and copyright/premium watermark in the video player.

patches.name: Disable splash ads
patches.description: Disables cold-start splash advertisement loading and countdown timer.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Disables internal Bilibili telemetry, APM profiling, TradPlus ad mediation, Firebase analytics, Crashlytics, and Facebook AppEvents.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Uses Morphe GmsCore for Google sign-in and sign-out.

patches.name: Hide bottom navigation items
patches.description: Hide selected bottom navigation bar tabs (Discover, Create, Chats, Me, Shorts).

options.description: Hides the Discover tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the center Create (+) button from the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the Chats (Messages) tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the Me (Profile) tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Hides the Shorts tab from the bottom navigation bar if present.

patches.name: Hide home search bar
patches.description: Hides the search bar on the Home screen.

options.description: Hides the search bar and collapses the top container on the Home screen.

patches.name: Hide home tab bar items
patches.description: Hide selected horizontal tab bar items on the home screen (Featured, Plaza, Subscriptions, Anime, Shorts, Community, Campaigns).

options.description: Hides the Featured / For You tab from the home tab bar.
Hides the Plaza / Channel tab from the home tab bar.
Hides promotional, event, and activity tabs (e.g. Dapatkan Itabag, Gratis Sementara, limited-time events).
Hides the Subscriptions tab from the home tab bar.
Hides the Anime tab from the home tab bar.
Hides the Shorts tab from the home tab bar.
Hides the Community (Opus) tab from the home tab bar.

patches.name: Pure discover search bar
patches.description: Removes discover tabs and trending searches to make the Discover page a pure search bar.

options.description: Hides the sliding tab strip and ViewPager2 content on the Discover page.
Hides trending searches and suppresses loading spinner on the Discover page.

patches.name: Disable tracking and analytics (Experimental)
patches.description: Attempts to block background telemetry and trackers. Not guaranteed to stop 100% of data collection.

patches.name: Enable browser
patches.description: Shows the browser in the projected mirror grid for non-SDK mode.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Uses Morphe GmsCore for Google sign-in and sign-out.

patches.name: Unlock VIP features
patches.description: Enables Mapbox, Google Maps, Spotify integration, and TwinSpace features.
